entities.name: Verazol
entities.description: Colossal two-mouthed serpent living by the Magosi Waterfall on Tazeem.

entities.name: Magosi Waterfall
entities.description: Tallest waterfall along the Umara River, with a portage area atop it.

entities.name: Akiri
entities.description: Defended a merfolk caravan from Verazol and survived.

entities.name: Zareth San
entities.description: Defended a merfolk caravan from Verazol and survived.

events.summary: Verazol strikes a merfolk commercial caravan near the Magosi Waterfall; Akiri and Zareth San fail to defend it and are the only survivors.
events.quote: Akiri and Zareth San attempted to defend the caravan but were ultimately unsuccessful

relations.quote: the serpent struck with lethal force
